claim_scope: Public tabular benchmark of conformal threshold transport under selected deployment-style shifts in BRFSS, NHANES, and UCI readmission data.
no_general_necessity_claim: The manuscript explicitly does not claim that target-domain recalibration is necessary in general or uniformly superior to all source-only/adaptation-aware alternatives.
source_baseline_scope: Comparative claims are limited to source split conformal and one implemented clipped source-only importance-weighting baseline.
primary_shift_variables_retained: Primary analyses retain shift-defining variables when they are part of the harmonized feature space, reflecting observable deployment boundaries.
shift_level_primary_inference: The manuscript now treats 12 non-pseudo deployment shifts as primary inferential units: source shift vs random coverage-error mean diff 0.113, median 0.049, p=4.9e-04; target10 vs source shortfall mean diff -0.101, median -0.034, p=0.021.
shift_defining_ablation: Sensitivity drops exact defining variables for all 12 shifts; source split mean shortfall remains 0.0609 and target10 shortfall is 0.0006; target-minus-source shortfall median is -0.0291, Wilcoxon p=1.19e-08.
l2_backbone_sensitivity: L2-SGD backbone reproduces the qualitative result: source split median coverage 0.8597/shortfall 0.0403 and target10 split median coverage 0.9001/shortfall 0.0.
mechanism_diagnostic: Target oracle q90 minus source qhat tracks source undercoverage across 60 shift-run pairs with Spearman r=0.946.
inferential_unit: Primary inference uses 12 non-pseudo deployment shifts after averaging over seeds; 60 matched shift-run analyses are repeated-split sensitivity summaries.
budget_uncertainty: Target budget table now reports shift-level coverage, shortfall, and set-size bootstrap intervals across all target fractions.
subgroup_scope: Class-conditional results and demographic subgroup audit are descriptive and are not claimed as fairness or subgroup-conditional validity guarantees; subgroup audit now reports pooled worst values plus per-shift worst subgroup cases with denominators.
clinical_scope: BRFSS/NHANES are unweighted prediction tables; UCI is patient-first and dated; the work is framed as a methodological stress test, not clinical deployment validation.
target_sampling: Target domain is split into 30% pool and 70% fixed test; budget samples are stratified deterministic draws from the pool with minimum 100 where possible.
uci_cohort: UCI raw encounters are sorted by encounter_id and deduplicated by patient_nbr, retaining first encounter before defining readmitted <30 as the label.
result_files: results/ contains conformal results, subgroup coverage, ablation, statistical tests, mechanism score diagnostics, and L2 sensitivity CSVs.
paper_outputs: writing/paper/main.pdf, cohort_definitions.tex, primary_shift_level_inference.tex, demographic_subgroup_audit.tex, shift_subgroup_worst_cases.tex, target_budget_shift_uncertainty.tex, figures/system_architecture.png, figures/experiment_setup.png, figures/score_threshold_mismatch.png
